worldcombat.skill.embargo.summary: Temporarily seals item use. Pokémon lose held-item effects; ordinary bodies pause eating, drinking, guarding, charging, and held-item interactions. Items remain in place.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.use.0: Seal an opponent that relies on its held item
worldcombat.skill.embargo.use.1: Hold a target's hands before an item exchange
worldcombat.skill.embargo.use.2: Stop a target from receiving an item from an ally
worldcombat.skill.embargo.description.0: Seals a target within %2$s blocks for %1$s seconds, ending naturally or when cleared.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.description.1: The seal prevents eating, drinking, guarding, charging, held-item interactions, and receiving Bestow gifts. Pokémon held-item effects are also suppressed.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.deep.on: Deep lock on: seal duration x1.35 and cooldown +14 ticks, holding one target down for longer.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.deep.off: Deep lock off: seal duration x0.75 and cooldown -8 ticks, shorter but more frequent.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.growth.0: At level %1$s the seal duration rises to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.growth.1: At level %1$s the seal duration rises to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.embargo.preference.dee: On = deep lock: duration x1.35 and cooldown +14 ticks, holding one target down longer. Off = quick lock: duration x0.75 and cooldown -8 ticks. Duration trades against cast frequency.
The companion only seals an item holder within this distance; smaller means only at close range, larger means reaching item holders from farther away.
On: only used when the target carries an item, as a dedicated item-denial tool. Off: bare-handed targets are sealed too, closing off any item they might receive.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to seal a target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
